app.name: Tatlas
app.tagline: Find the right tattoo artist near you

common.report: Report a mistake or request removal

map.empty: No studios here. Move the map or clear the filters.
map.errorHint: Check that the backend is running and that the server address in Settings is correct.

location.ask: 📍 See studios near you: tap to use your location (only while using the app).
location.openSettings: 📍 Location is off for Tatlas. Tap to open settings.

studio.noArtists: No artist has linked their profile to this studio yet.
studio.claimHint: Claim the studio to manage its details, or add it to your studios from your artist profile.

settings.title: Settings
settings.serverHint: Tatlas backend address. To test on a phone use your PC's IP on the same Wi-Fi, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8000
settings.unreachable: Saved, but the server does not answer. Check IP, port and that phone and PC are on the same network.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.hint: Use fictional data bundled in the app, no server needed. Studios, artists and images are made up.
demo.offer: Want to try the app without a server?

account.title: My account
account.guestLead: Log in to create your tattoo artist profile, say where you work and publish your portfolio. No account is needed to search for artists.
account.name: Name
account.iAmArtist: I'm a tattoo artist and want to create my profile
account.privacy: I accept the privacy notice: my data is only used to manage my account and public profile, and I can ask for deletion at any time.
account.privacyRequired: You must accept the privacy notice.
account.networkError: Something went wrong. Check the connection to the server.
account.demoUnavailable: Accounts are not available in demo mode: data is fictional and there is no server. Turn demo mode off in Settings to connect to the backend.
account.profilePublic: ✓ Your profile is verified and visible to everyone.
account.profilePending: ⏳ Profile awaiting verification: only you can see it until an admin approves it.
account.becomeArtist: Are you a tattoo artist? Create your profile: you'll appear on the map in the studios where you work.
account.myStudios: Where I work (studios and guest spots)
account.verificationNotice: After saving, your profile stays private until an admin verifies it.
account.removePresence: Remove this studio from your profile?
account.noPresences: You haven't said where you work yet.
account.newStudioHint: Enter the address and we'll place it on the map. You'll manage the studio.
account.photoPermission: Photo or camera permission is needed.
account.longPressDelete: Long-press a work to delete it.
account.deleteWarning: Your account, artist profile, portfolio photos and studio links will be permanently deleted. Studios you manage will lose their owner. This cannot be undone.

claim.title: Claim this studio
claim.loginCta: Log in to claim this studio
claim.intro: Ask to manage “{{name}}”. An admin will review the request: add a link proving your connection to the studio (website, the studio's Instagram…).
claim.evidenceHint: Optional, but it speeds up verification.
claim.sent: Request sent. You'll see the outcome in the app.
